import sys,json,argparse,subprocess,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'artifacts/webtransport';sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import inspection
original=subprocess.Popen;client=[None];roles={}
def popen(cmd,*a,**kw):
 if cmd[0]=='perf':
  cmd=list(cmd);index=cmd.index('-p');roles['server']=int(cmd[index+1]);roles['client']=client[0]
  assert roles['client'];cmd[index+1]+=','+str(roles['client']);cmd[cmd.index('-e')+1]='cycles';cmd[cmd.index('-F')+1]='249';cmd+=['-m','512'];cmd=['sudo','-n']+cmd
 p=original(cmd,*a,**kw)
 if any(Path(str(x)).name=='inspection' for x in cmd):client[0]=p.pid
 return p
subprocess.Popen=popen
for v in ['event-batch','packet-spaces']:
 client[0]=None;roles.clear()
 source=out/'thin-pending-final-mixed.json';a=json.loads(source.read_text())['args'];a.update(server=str(out/f'binaries/{v}-relay'),profile=True,seconds=8,output=str(out/f'packet-spaces-reliable-mixed-{v}-profile.json'))
 for k in ['server','client','client_source_root','tls_front','tls_cert','tls_key','tls_ca','heap_profile','heap_library','output','fanout_latency_output']:
  if a.get(k) is not None:a[k]=Path(a[k])
 r=inspection.run(argparse.Namespace(**a));assert r['passed'];data=a['output'].with_suffix('.perf.data')
 for role,pid in roles.items():
  text=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','-g','none','--pid',str(pid),'--sort','dso,symbol','--percentage','relative','--percent-limit','0.3','-i',str(data)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
  assert 'Total Lost Samples: 0' in text
  (out/f'packet-spaces-reliable-{v}-{role}-symbols.txt').write_text(text)
 (out/f'packet-spaces-reliable-{v}-profile-roles.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(roles),indent=2))
 subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','chown',f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}',str(data)],check=True)
 print('DONE',v,roles,flush=True)

import subprocess,json,os
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('artifacts/webtransport');env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('WAR_')};env['RUST_LOG']='war_relay=debug'
commands=[['artifacts/webtransport/binaries/packet-spaces-relay','--dev-cert','--bind','127.0.0.1:14438','--admin-bind','127.0.0.1:14439','--workers','4','--messages-per-second','0','--bytes-per-second','0'],['python3','-m','http.server','14440','--bind','127.0.0.1','--directory','target/browser']]
processes=[]
try:
 for i,c in enumerate(commands):
  with (out/f'packet-spaces-browser-live-process-{i}.log').open('x') as f:p=subprocess.Popen(c,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=f)
  processes.append(p)
 print('READY',[(p.pid,c) for p,c in zip(processes,commands)],flush=True)
 input()
finally:
 for p in reversed(processes):
  p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=10)
 print('STOPPED',[p.returncode for p in processes],flush=True)
